name: boardsmyth
description: Describe what you want your board to do. AI writes, compiles, fixes and uploads the program.
author: Code Crafted Nexus LLC

scripts.dev:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.dist: npm run fetch-cli && npm run build && node scripts/require-signing.mjs && electron-builder --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:mac: npm run fetch-cli && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:linux: npm run fetch-cli && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:unsigned: npm run fetch-cli && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
